prompt: Elena will read the plant supervisor’s statement at the customer meeting. The supervisor wrote it and takes responsibility for it, but has asked Elena to speak ____ him.
promptZh: Elena 將在客戶會議上宣讀廠務主管的聲明。聲明由主管撰寫並由他負責，但他請 Elena ____ 他發言。

options.whyZh: 主管撰寫並對內容負責，Elena 受託代他宣讀，正是 speak on behalf of someone。
她受託傳達主管的聲明，沒有表示異議。
文中只指定 Elena 代讀，沒有說主管也將另外發言。
她有明確委託，內容依主管書面聲明，不是忽略主管。

explanationZh: 主管撰寫並對內容負責，Elena 受託代他宣讀，正是 speak on behalf of someone。
evidence: Elena will read the plant supervisor’s statement at the customer meeting. The supervisor wrote it and takes responsibility for it, but has asked Elena to speak on behalf of him.

vocabulary.note: 正式表達立場、責任或資訊的文字或發言。
